findings.title: Consumer ORDERS/billing is waiting for acks
findings.detail: No new messages go out until clients acknowledge some. Either they don't ack (check ack handling), or the limit is too low for how many they process at once.

findings.title: Consumer ORDERS/shipping is paused
findings.detail: It delivers nothing until resumed or its pause deadline passes; messages keep piling up.

rules.doc: A server that answered before has missed two checks in a row.
A responding server reports itself unhealthy (for example JetStream not current).
Servers in one cluster run different NATS versions.
The slow-consumer count went up in the last 5 minutes.
A server has more than 90% of max_connections in use.
A clustered JetStream server sees no meta leader, so streams can't be created or changed.
JetStream file storage is over 80% (warning) or 95% (critical) of a server or account limit.
A replicated stream has no leader, so it accepts no writes.
A stream replica's server hasn't been seen by the stream leader recently.
A stream replica has been behind its leader for more than a minute.
A consumer's pending count has only gone up for the last 15 minutes.
A consumer is paused (NATS 2.11+), so nothing is delivered from it.
A consumer has as many unacknowledged messages as max_ack_pending allows, so delivery has stopped.
More than 10% of a consumer's deliveries over the last 15 minutes were redeliveries.
A push consumer has no subscriber on its deliver subject.
A pull consumer has messages waiting but no client has pulled for over 5 minutes.
None of a consumer's filter subjects overlap the stream's subjects, so it can never receive anything.
